dog.description_text:
Meet Chelsea! This tiny pup is a 100% sweetheart and absolute bundle of joy. True to her young puppy nature, Chelsea is very playful. She loves a play session followed by snuggle time. She is also making good progress with her crate training.

As a young pup, Chelsea will need a fun, dedicated adopter ready to keep her curious mind engaged with routine, basic training, and puppy manners as she grows. We think she has a bit more growing to do, but will probably stay a compact size! If you're looking for a friendly companion to fill your days with love and laughter, Chelsea might just be your perfect match.

Registered adopters interested in Chelsea can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
